title: GET /api/v1/team
description: Team v1 (desktop spec §5.10): the tenant's principals as the schema knows them plus live invites, the shared-memory flag, the tenant's 30d TVO summary (null when the report refuses), and placeholders that are null until their feature lands.

id.description: the principal subject, device:<uuid>, or invite:<uuid>

name.description: no users table: null until one lands

email.description: the invited address on an invite row; null on a principal

invite_link.description: the raw token is answered once by POST /team/invites; m1_081 keeps only its hash

fleet_status.description: enterprise fleet/gateway status: null until it exists
